output.assistant_visual_observation: Glasses, graying hair, and facial hair remained visible. Clothing became a dark knit top on a light blue-gray background. The face still looked largely photographic with some sketch-like texture, short of the proposed semi-realistic hand-drawn style. No obvious head/neck/shoulder mismatch was visible in the full image.

checks_not_performed: Circular or small-size avatar crop inspection
Independent human review or identity-fidelity measurement
